claim_boundary: Two controlled size-9 cases test whether the real XHub parser can sit inside GraphPUCT and feed exact LFP online. This is an end-to-end mechanism smoke, not a compute-matched comparison, a natural-data generalization result, or an algorithmic-advantage claim.

protocol.accounting: logical evaluations, run memo hits, parser cache hits, and actual paid XHub calls separated
protocol.branch_commit: validated fragments only; overlapping source observations unioned by Horn semantics
protocol.feedback: exact LFP closure, query-rule body satisfaction, and unresolved predicates
protocol.gold_boundary: gold sidecar loaded only after all search cases completed
protocol.graph_merge: exact semantic transposition-table key; action order is not part of the key
protocol.parser: query-independent XHub window parser + fail-closed source-grounded validator
protocol.window_policy: center + directed-neighbor + SCC-order fill; unordered duplicates removed

status_interpretation: PASS means the two-case end-to-end mechanism and safety gates passed; it does not establish a performance advantage.
